description: Scrape TikTok hashtag metadata and/or posts. Metadata mode is always reliable. Posts mode may be blocked by TikTok; auto mode tries posts then falls back gracefully.

hashtags.description: List of TikTok hashtags to scrape. You can include or omit the # symbol. Example: comedy, #dance, fyp
hashtags.title: Hashtags

includeHashtagMetadata.description: When scraping posts, also emit a 'hashtag_metadata' record with the challenge stats (videoCount, viewCount, description, etc.) at the start of each hashtag's results.
includeHashtagMetadata.title: Include Hashtag Metadata

maxPostsPerHashtag.description: Maximum number of posts to scrape per hashtag (when mode includes posts). Set to 0 to skip posts entirely (equivalent to metadata-only mode). Has no effect in metadata-only mode.
maxPostsPerHashtag.title: Max Posts Per Hashtag

mode.description: What to scrape per hashtag. 'metadata' emits one stats record per hashtag (always works). 'posts' fetches videos (may be blocked). 'topPosts' tries a search fallback. 'auto' tries posts, falls back to topPosts, then metadata-only.
enumTitles: Posts (videos — may be blocked by TikTok)
mode.title: Scrape Mode

title: TikTok Hashtag Scraper Input
